whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Patna Gym,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.7★ reviews with 310+ ratings in Chitkohra, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://patnagym.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Patna Gym Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Patna Gym) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and highlighting your 4.7-star rating in Chitkohra, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
